zh-CN.AGENT_SESSION_INVALID_ARGUMENT: 会话请求参数不符合接口要求，请检查后重试。
zh-CN.AGENT_SESSION_UNAUTHORIZED: 需要有效的插件服务凭证。
zh-CN.AGENT_SESSION_FORBIDDEN: 当前插件未获授权执行此会话操作。
zh-CN.AGENT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND: 会话或会话资源不存在。
zh-CN.AGENT_SESSION_CONFLICT: 会话状态或重复请求发生冲突，请检查当前状态。
zh-CN.AGENT_SESSION_IDEMPOTENCY_EXPIRED: 请求幂等键已过期，请确认执行结果后使用新键。
zh-CN.AGENT_SESSION_CONTEXT_EXPIRED: 会话待处理状态已过期，请创建新会话后重新提交。
zh-CN.AGENT_SESSION_EVENT_CURSOR_EXPIRED: 会话事件恢复游标已过期，请重新查询调用状态。
zh-CN.AGENT_SESSION_UPSTREAM_DEPENDENCY: 会话服务依赖暂时不可用。
zh-CN.archive.backpressure: 运行归档积压已达到容量阈值，请稍后重试。
zh-CN.archive.health_stale: 运行存储健康状态暂不可用，请稍后重试。

en-US.AGENT_SESSION_INVALID_ARGUMENT: The session request does not match the API contract.
en-US.AGENT_SESSION_UNAUTHORIZED: A valid plugin service credential is required.
en-US.AGENT_SESSION_FORBIDDEN: This plugin is not authorized for the session operation.
en-US.AGENT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND: The session or session resource was not found.
en-US.AGENT_SESSION_CONFLICT: The session state or repeated request conflicts with the current operation.
en-US.AGENT_SESSION_IDEMPOTENCY_EXPIRED: The idempotency key has expired. Check the execution outcome before using a new key.
en-US.AGENT_SESSION_CONTEXT_EXPIRED: The pending session state has expired. Create a new session before resubmitting.
en-US.AGENT_SESSION_EVENT_CURSOR_EXPIRED: The session event recovery cursor has expired. Query the invocation status again.
en-US.AGENT_SESSION_UPSTREAM_DEPENDENCY: A session service dependency is unavailable.
en-US.archive.backpressure: Run archive backlog has reached its limit. Retry later.
en-US.archive.health_stale: Run storage health is temporarily unavailable. Retry later.
